items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: The American propaganda had been so tough on the Kaiser and that, we didn't know whether they were ready to turn us into sausage or not

ctx.x: And see, now, the people were -- everybody, everything was quiet, see. Because they don't know what we -- whether we're going to jump up and grab the chandeliers or not. They don't know what's going to happen. So we started off. When we finished this number, everything, for about two or three seconds, nothing happened. Everybody set there, (sings). And see,

we said, 'Oh, god, what's happening here.' The American propaganda had been so tough on the Kaiser and that, we didn't know whether they were ready to turn us into sausage or not, you see. So, but, and then when they did start, they started hollering, 'Bis, Bis'. Well, we thought they were saying 'beasts'. They were saying 'bis', encore. But it sounded like to me, they were calling us beasts, b-e-a-s-t.
